verdict.rationale: CSC's own pages say it offers bi-directional integrations via 'modern APIs' and secure APIs for ELM, claims and payroll systems. That shows the product has an API surface, but the wording suggests vendor-delivered integration services rather than a self-serve public API, and probes for an OpenAPI spec and llms.txt all returned 404. Missing for 10: publicly accessible API reference documentation, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, self-serve authentication/keys, endpoint coverage of core actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Enable secure bi-directional integrations with enterprise and third-party systems via modern APIs
CSC provides integration services for systems like enterprise legal management (ELM), claims, and payroll through secure application programming interfaces (APIs).
